description: This file defines the `BreadCrumbStack` PHP class responsible for managing breadcrumb navigation history for users within the SuiteCRM application. It handles storing, retrieving, and updating a list of breadcrumb items based on user activity in the tracker database, including functionalities for adding, removing, and filtering breadcrumb entries.

classes.name: BreadCrumbStack
classes.description: A class that manages an ordered list of breadcrumb items for a user, stored in session and/or database, allowing addition, removal, and filtering of breadcrumb entries based on user activity tracked in the database.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the breadcrumb stack for a user by querying recent tracking data from the database, populating the internal stack accordingly.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a breadcrumb item with a specific item_id exists in the stack.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Adds a new breadcrumb item to the stack, updating visibility and maintaining uniqueness.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes the earliest breadcrumb item from the stack.

methods.name: makeItemInvisible
methods.description: Sets a tracker entry as invisible or deletes it from the database depending on the configuration.

methods.name: popItem
methods.description: Removes a specific breadcrumb item from the stack based on item_id.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds a breadcrumb item to the internal stack and updates the map.

methods.name: heal
methods.description: Rebuilds the internal indices after removal of an item to maintain consistency.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the current number of breadcrumb items in the stack.

methods.name: getBreadCrumbList
methods.description: Returns the list of current breadcrumb items, optionally filtered by module name, with a maximum of 10 entries.
